01 / How it works

Simple by design.

A waterless urinal still connects to drainage. What changes is how urine leaves the bowl and how odour is controlled.

01

Let gravity do the work

Urine flows into the drainage system without a flush cycle or flushing water supply.

02

Keep odour in check

The MB Active odour trap is a core part of the system. Correct installation and care matter.

03

Keep care consistent

Clean routinely and replace consumables as required. Waterless does not mean maintenance-free.

03 / FAQ

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Does it really use no flushing water?

Yes. Waterless urinals use no water for flushing. Cleaning still requires an appropriate routine and products.

Will it work in my existing washroom?

A retrofit may be possible. Drainage, mounting, existing plumbing and local requirements need a site-specific assessment.

What about odour and cleaning?

The odour trap, correct installation and consistent cleaning all play a role. Your team needs instructions and a consumables replacement routine.

Can I get a site-specific price?

Yes. Call Swiss Eco Media to discuss your location, quantities and project scope. Calculator values are examples, not prices.
